Audit the complete implication geom:multiplicity -> geom:curve-inequality -> geom:interpolation in the September 24, 2026 staged manuscript. Establish an exact literal refutation or an independent general verification, without certifying the final irrationality theorem.

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 017 (The irrationality exponent of π is 2.; papers: The irrationality exponent of pi is 2; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/017.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.
Independently verify or exactly refute the complete separated-weight interpolation implication; do not infer the final irrationality theorem from this scoped result alone.
For every real nu>2, |pi-p/q| >= q^(-nu) for all integers p and sufficiently large integers q.
Weighted transverse derivative persistence implies the normal-basis product inequality, uniformly in N, the equations, the component, and the commuting analytic frame.
Separated products and all normal-basis inequalities force a persistent algebraic obstruction into a constant-Y fiber, and in that fiber into a proper coordinate flat.
Under geom:sigma and geom:separation, every irreducible algebraic curve satisfies deg_W C >= (1+sigma) times its total weighted branch contact at the prescribed centers.

The strict curve inequality implies eventual weighted jet surjectivity using an ordinary blowup, ampleness, eventual ordinary Rees powers, and Serre vanishing, without smoothness or normality at infinity.

For m,K>=1 and positive rational w0,v0,theta with theta<1, K theta^m<1, K(w0/v0)theta^m<1, sufficiently successively separated positive weights chosen before coordinatewise-distinct centers give surjectivity for all sufficiently large divisible H.
A full-row minor supplied by interpolation satisfies det:lower after Gaussian-integer denominator clearing.
The exact row translation identity and its scalar bounds hold for every determinant row.
The collision estimate supplies the analytic upper bound with the stated simultaneous parameter dependence.
The arithmetic and analytic determinant bounds are incompatible under det:contradiction-conditions.
For every nu>2, the successive dimension, approximation, and weight choices satisfy all interpolation and determinant hypotheses with a strict contradiction margin.

claims.natural_statement: Over an arbitrary field, a tangent subspace whose sum with a linear hyperplane is proper lies in that hyperplane. The nonzero-Y logarithmic shear is an invertible linear map with inverse coordinates v0/y and vi-v0/y. Product separation and all-pairs normal-basis bounds force the maximal positive direction into every frame basis; in a positive-coordinate family they force uniqueness of the basis index set.

Let m,K>=1, 0<theta<1, and w0,v0>0 be rational, with K(w0/v0)theta^m<1. For each nonempty T subset of {1,...,m}, fix an integer n_T>=1 with n_T theta^|T|<1. Then successive weight thresholds independent of center locations give eventual logarithmically sheared weighted jet surjectivity at every configuration of K distinct centers (b_j,c_j) with b_j nonzero for which every flat Y=b and X_i=d_i for i outside T contains at most n_T centers. A flat containing n centers with n theta^|T|>1 is an eventual rank obstruction for any positive coordinate weights. Equality is not decided.

Over an arbitrary field, a tangent subspace whose sum with a linear hyperplane is proper lies in that hyperplane. The nonzero-Y logarithmic shear is an invertible linear map with inverse coordinates v0/y and vi-v0/y. Product separation and all-pairs normal-basis bounds force the maximal positive direction into every frame basis; in a positive-coordinate family they force uniqueness of the basis index set.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

namespace InterpolationAudit

section Hyperplane

variable {K V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]

theorem tangent_in_hyperplane (ell : V →ₗ[K] K) (T : Submodule K V)
    (hproper : ell.ker ⊔ T ≠ ⊤) : T ≤ ell.ker := by
  by_contra h
  change ¬ (∀ t, t ∈ T → t ∈ ell.ker) at h
  push_neg at h
  obtain ⟨t, htT, htker⟩ := h
  have ht0 : ell t ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [LinearMap.mem_ker] using htker
  apply hproper
  apply top_unique
  intro v _
  let c := ell v / ell t
  have hvker : v - c • t ∈ ell.ker := by
    change ell (v - c • t) = 0
    simp only [map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    dsimp [c]
    field_simp
  exact Submodule.mem_sup.mpr
    ⟨v - c • t, hvker, c • t, T.smul_mem c htT, sub_add_cancel v (c • t)⟩

end Hyperplane

section LogarithmicFrame

variable {K I : Type*} [Field K]

def logShear (y : K) (v : Option I → K) : Option I → K
  | none => y * v none
  | some i => v none + v (some i)

def logUnshear (y : K) (v : Option I → K) : Option I → K
  | none => v none / y
  | some i => v (some i) - v none / y

theorem logShear_add (y : K) (u v : Option I → K) :
    logShear y (u + v) = logShear y u + logShear y v := by
  funext j
  cases j <;> simp [logShear] <;> ring

theorem logShear_smul (y a : K) (v : Option I → K) :
    logShear y (a • v) = a • logShear y v := by
  funext j
  cases j <;> simp [logShear, smul_eq_mul] <;> ring

theorem logUnshear_logShear (y : K) (hy : y ≠ 0) (v : Option I → K) :
    logUnshear y (logShear y v) = v := by
  funext j
  cases j <;> simp [logShear, logUnshear, hy]

theorem logShear_logUnshear (y : K) (hy : y ≠ 0) (v : Option I → K) :
    logShear y (logUnshear y v) = v := by
  funext j
  cases j <;> simp [logShear, logUnshear, hy]

def logarithmicFrameEquiv (y : K) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    (Option I → K) ≃ₗ[K] (Option I → K) where
  toFun := logShear y
  invFun := logUnshear y
  left_inv := logUnshear_logShear y hy
  right_inv := logShear_logUnshear y hy
  map_add' := logShear_add y
  map_smul' := logShear_smul y

def logNormal (y : K) (i : I) : (Option I → K) →ₗ[K] K where
  toFun v := v (some i) - v none / y
  map_add' u v := by
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, add_div]
    ring
  map_smul' a v := by
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring

theorem tangent_logarithmic_relation (y : K) (i : I)
    (T : Submodule K (Option I → K))
    (hproper : (logNormal y i).ker ⊔ T ≠ ⊤) :
    ∀ v ∈ T, v (some i) = v none / y := by
  have hT := tangent_in_hyperplane (logNormal y i) T hproper
  intro v hv
  have hz := hT hv
  change v (some i) - v none / y = 0 at hz
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz

end LogarithmicFrame

section SeparatedBases

def wins (A B : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ i, 0 < i ∧ i ∈ A ∧ i ∉ B ∧
    ∀ j ∈ (A \ B) ∪ (B \ A), j ≤ i

theorem largest_direction_forced (w v : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (A B : Finset ℕ) (i : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hiA : i ∈ A)
    (hmax : ∀ j ∈ A ∪ B, j ≤ i)
    (hbound : A.prod w ≤ C * B.prod v)
    (hsep : wins A B → C * B.prod v < A.prod w) : i ∈ B := by
  by_contra hiB
  have hwin : wins A B := by
    refine ⟨i, hi, hiA, hiB, ?_⟩
    intro j hj
    apply hmax j
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hj with hAB | hBA
    · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hAB).1)
    · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hBA).1)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hbound) (hsep hwin)

theorem wins_total (A B : Finset ℕ) (hne : A ≠ B)
    (hA : ∀ i ∈ A, 0 < i) (hB : ∀ i ∈ B, 0 < i) :
    wins A B ∨ wins B A := by
  classical
  let S := (A \ B) ∪ (B \ A)
  have hS : S.Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    have hz : S = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h
    apply hne
    ext j
    have hj : j ∉ S := by rw [hz]; simp
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_sdiff] at hj
    tauto
  have himem := Finset.max'_mem S hS
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp himem with hAB | hBA
  · obtain ⟨hiA, hiB⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hAB
    left
    exact ⟨S.max' hS, hA _ hiA, hiA, hiB,
      fun j hj => Finset.le_max' S j hj⟩
  · obtain ⟨hiB, hiA⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hBA
    right
    refine ⟨S.max' hS, hB _ hiB, hiB, hiA, ?_⟩
    intro j hj
    apply Finset.le_max' S j
    have hcomm : (B \ A) ∪ (A \ B) = S := Finset.union_comm _ _
    rwa [hcomm] at hj

theorem unique_positive_basis_family (F : Finset (Finset ℕ))
    (w v : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ A ∈ F, ∀ i ∈ A, 0 < i)
    (hbound : ∀ A ∈ F, ∀ B ∈ F, A.prod w ≤ C * B.prod v)
    (hsep : ∀ A ∈ F, ∀ B ∈ F,
      wins A B → C * B.prod v < A.prod w) :
    ∀ A ∈ F, ∀ B ∈ F, A = B := by
  intro A hAF B hBF
  by_contra hne
  rcases wins_total A B hne (hpos A hAF) (hpos B hBF) with hAB | hBA
  · exact (not_lt_of_ge (hbound A hAF B hBF)) (hsep A hAF B hBF hAB)
  · exact (not_lt_of_ge (hbound B hBF A hAF)) (hsep B hBF A hAF hBA)

end SeparatedBases

end InterpolationAudit

#print axioms InterpolationAudit.tangent_in_hyperplane
#print axioms InterpolationAudit.logarithmicFrameEquiv
#print axioms InterpolationAudit.largest_direction_forced
#print axioms InterpolationAudit.unique_positive_basis_family
